LanguageData.AWA_EnableModTooltip: When checked, the mod will manage work priorities.
LanguageData.AWA_EnableDailyRefreshTooltip: If enabled, assignments will be refreshed automatically at the start of each day.
LanguageData.AWA_DesiredPawnsLabel: Configure Count (0=disabled) and Priority (1=Highest, 4=Lowest) per Job:
LanguageData.AWA_ModDisabledMessage: Automated Work Assignment is currently disabled.
LanguageData.AWA_ExclusionDialogDesc: Select pawns to exclude from automatic assignment:
LanguageData.AWA_IncludeTaskTooltip: Uncheck to exclude this task from automatic assignment. The mod will ignore this task completely.
LanguageData.AWA_ToggleCountModeTooltip: Click to switch between Fixed Count (#) and Percentage (%) mode for assignments.
LanguageData.AWA_LoadSaveFirst: Load a save game to configure Automated Work Assignment settings.
LanguageData.AWA_ConfigureExpertModeTooltip: Click to open the advanced rule editor to assign priorities based on skill ranges.
LanguageData.AWA_ExpertMode_SelectWorkTypePrompt: Select a work type from the left list to configure its rules.
LanguageData.AWA_ExpertMode_NoRulesDefined: No rules defined for this work type yet.
LanguageData.AWA_ExpertMode_LoadSaveFirst: Load a save game first to configure Expert Mode rules.
LanguageData.AWA_AssignmentMode_Simple_Tooltip: Uses only the Count/Priority sliders below. Expert Mode rules are ignored.
LanguageData.AWA_AssignmentMode_Expert_Tooltip: Uses ONLY skill-based rules from Expert Mode. Simple sliders are ignored (except Count/Percentage).
LanguageData.AWA_AssignmentMode_Hybrid_Tooltip: Expert rules override when they match. Simple Mode is fallback for unmatched skills.
LanguageData.AWA_ForceEmergencyPriorities_Tooltip: When enabled, Doctor and Firefighter are always forced to priority 1, overriding all other settings.
LanguageData.AWA_PrioritizePassion_Tooltip: When enabled, pawns are sorted by passion FIRST, then skill. Useful for training passionate colonists.
LanguageData.AWA_PassionWeight_Tooltip:
How much passion affects assignment priority.
0x = Ignore passion entirely
1x = Default balance
3x = Strongly prefer passionate pawns
LanguageData.AWA_BackupPriority_Tooltip: Priority for colonists NOT in top selection.\n0 = Disable work\n1-4 = Backup priority (useful for Hauling/Cleaning)
LanguageData.AWA_ExcludePawns_Tooltip: Select specific pawns to exclude from this job type.
LanguageData.AWA_AddRule_Tooltip: Adds a new skill-based priority rule for this work type.
LanguageData.AWA_NoSkillWarning: ⚠ WARNING: {0} has no skill associated.\nExpert Mode rules will use Social skill as fallback.\nConsider using Simple Mode for this work type instead.
LanguageData.AWA_ExpertMode_Info: Expert Mode uses the Count/Percentage settings from the main Simple Mode sliders.\nRules below define which priorities (1-4) to assign based on skill levels.
LanguageData.AWA_WorkTypeNoSkill_Tooltip: {0} has no associated skill. Expert rules will use Social skill as fallback.
LanguageData.AWA_Experimental_Warning: WARNING: This feature collects context data (Biome, Resources, Temperature) when you manually assign priorities to create a profile of your playstyle. It may impact game performance.

AWA_Experimental_CPUWarning.color: Lower values mean it reacts faster to situation changes but consumes more CPU.

LanguageData.AWA_EnableExperimentalHeuristics_Tooltip: Activates the profiling and heuristic assignment logic.
LanguageData.AWA_JobExclusion_SubDesc1: Excluded pawns will never be assigned to this job by the mod.
LanguageData.AWA_JobExclusion_SubDesc2: (They can still be manually assigned in the Work tab)
